name: UI shortcuts
author: Brett
description: Open anything in the UI by name or by voice (Brett, Nov 6 2026: "Create a registry so I can open them with my voice"). Every screen, dialog, pop-up, settings interface and setting, menu and menu entry, navigation item, toolbar and button, link, tab, banner and widget of every app and plugin is an item in the UI registry (ui-registry@1, one asset per app: apps/<app>/src/assets/ui-registry/<app>.json, filled by framework/cli/ui-registry.mjs and by what each running console reports). This plugin finds the item for what you typed or said (its id, label, an alias, a fuzzy match, or one of your own shortcuts) and opens it: a quick-open dialog (type or speak), the actions ui.open:<item>, ui-shortcuts.say:<words> and ui-shortcuts.dialog, Settings → Plugins → UI shortcuts (your shortcuts: a phrase → an item, with a spoken answer; the mic and spoken answers; what is registered per app). Everything is on the API, MCP and CLI through plugin-commands@1 (ui-shortcuts_say, ui-shortcuts_open, ui-shortcuts_items …; axf ui open <words>), so Gizmo, Molly and any Claude session open the same items; the spoken form is voice-command@1 shaped (GET /voice) for the Voice commands plugin and Molly. Opening is navigate-only through console-commands@1 (never a veto); an item whose action changes data needs the caller's own write grant.
